headline: High: Notion AI can ingest workspace content while Authelia has broad network egress, creating a plausible data-leak and compliance path; prompt-injection and write-conflict risks are lower.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: A direct injection bridge is not documented, but Notion AI reads workspace pages and Authelia can interact via OIDC/ForwardAuth outputs. The pair lacks a shared clipboard/MCP channel, so the main pathway is manual or content-mediated rather than automatic. Uncertainty keeps this above none, but below medium.
conditions: IF Authelia-generated text is pasted into a Notion page that Notion AI later summarizes
IF a workspace page contains attacker-controlled instructions that Notion AI treats as authoritative
mitigations: Label Authelia-generated content as untrusted in Notion pages
Avoid pasting raw auth logs or headers into pages used for AI Q&A
Add a review step before Notion AI summaries are reused
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to workspace content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI can access workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while Authelia has broad network egress and handles OIDC/ForwardAuth flows. No direct PHI/secrets are shown, but shared workspace content can be exposed to Notion vendor backends and downstream model providers. This is a default-configurable leakage path, though not clearly irreversible.
conditions: IF sensitive material is stored in Notion workspace pages accessible to Notion AI
IF Authelia-authenticated content is copied into those pages or summarized there
mitigations: Restrict sensitive pages from AI-enabled workspaces
Keep secrets and auth logs out of Notion pages
Review workspace sharing permissions for AI-accessible content
requires-engineering: enforce data-class labels and AI exclusion policies

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Authelia cannot write files or modify git state, and Notion AI is limited to Notion-controlled actions on workspace data. Their mutable surfaces do not overlap in a way that suggests direct write-write contention. The shared workspace state in Notion is real, but Authelia lacks the write primitives needed for a serious conflict.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator maps Authelia outputs into Notion edits
IF multiple Notion AI instances edit the same page without human review
mitigations: Use page-level ownership for AI-edited content
Avoid concurrent AI edits on the same database row
Review changes before publishing
requires-engineering: add locking around shared workspace mutations

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, so it may treat upstream text as authoritative. Authelia can emit authentication-related outputs that could be copied into Notion and then re-rendered or acted on. The pair does not show autonomous downstream action, so this is cascading misinformation rather than high-impact automation.
conditions: IF Authelia-generated claims are pasted into Notion pages used as source material
IF Notion AI answers are reused as operational instructions without verification
mitigations: Require human verification of AI-generated operational guidance
Separate source-of-truth pages from draft summaries
Add citations or links to original Authelia outputs
requires-engineering: build verification checks before downstream action

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to Notion vendor backends and downstream model providers, while Authelia has broad network egress and may sit in authentication flows. If regulated or sensitive workspace data is placed into Notion, residency and retention obligations can diverge from local expectations. The other agent is cited because Authelia can feed the content path.
conditions: IF EU PII or regulated records are stored in Notion pages accessible to Notion AI
IF organizational policy requires on-prem or residency-bound processing for authentication-related content
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI-enabled pages
Confirm vendor DPA and residency terms before use
Limit retention of AI-generated workspace content
requires-engineering: route regulated workflows to a residency-approved system
